Figure 1 presents two separate line diagrams concerning fiscal rules; one depicting an IMF fiscal rule index and the other displaying the number of fiscal rules. Both diagrams share a common x-axis representing years. The x-axis is linear, ranging from 1995 to 2020 in 5-year increments, and is labeled “Jahr” (Year). The y-axis for the left diagram, labeled “IMF-Fiscalregel-Index” (IMF Fiscal Rule Index), is linear, spanning from 0 to 120 with a tick interval of 20 and a unit of 1. The y-axis for the right diagram, labeled “Anzahl fiskalischer Regeln” (Number of Fiscal Rules), is linear, ranging from 0 to 70 with a tick interval of 10 and a unit of 1.  

In the left diagram, a blue line with triangle markers illustrates the IMF fiscal rule index. It begins at approximately 0.2 in 1995 and generally increases, reaching a peak of approximately 110.2 in 2008 before declining to approximately 82.9 in 2020.  In the right diagram, a green line with circle markers plots the number of fiscal rules. Starting at approximately 4 in 1995, it rises to a peak of approximately 64 in 2010 and then decreases to approximately 47.7 in 2020.
